texts.title: Oakley Leisure Centre — new membership options

paragraphs.text: From 1 October, Oakley Leisure Centre will offer three types of membership. Standard membership, at £32 a month, includes the gym, the swimming pool and all fitness classes.

Off-peak membership costs £22 a month and gives the same access, but only between 10 am and 4 pm on weekdays and at any time at weekends. Swim-only membership costs £18 a month and includes lane swimming at any time.
All members can bring a guest for £5 per visit. Children under 12 are not allowed in the gym, but they may use the pool with an adult.
Existing members will move to standard membership automatically unless they choose a different option by 20 September. Members can change their membership type once every three months.
The centre’s café, on the first floor, is open to members and non-members from 8 am to 8 pm. Members receive a ten per cent discount on hot drinks.
Check-in is from 3 pm and check-out is by 11 am. Guests who need to leave later can ask reception for a late check-out, which is free until 1 pm if rooms are available.
Breakfast is served in the restaurant from 7 am to 10 am and is included in all room rates. Guests who leave before 7 am can order a breakfast bag the evening before.
The hotel has a small gym on the lower ground floor, open 24 hours, and a spa that must be booked in advance. Towels for the spa are provided, but guests should bring their own swimwear.
Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The car park is free for guests but has only 20 spaces, so it is not possible to reserve a space in advance.
Pets are not allowed in the hotel, except for assistance dogs. If you expect to arrive after 10 pm, please let reception know when you book.

items.quote: Standard membership, at £32 a month, includes the gym, the swimming pool and all fitness classes

options.text: the gym, the pool and fitness classes.

explanation.en: “includes the gym, the swimming pool and all fitness classes” → B. Guests (D) cost £5, so they are not free.
explanation.kk: «includes the gym, the swimming pool and all fitness classes» → B. Қонақ (D) £5-ке кіреді, тегін емес.
explanation.ru: «includes the gym, the swimming pool and all fitness classes» → B. Гостей (D) приводят за £5, это не бесплатно.

items.quote: only between 10 am and 4 pm on weekdays and at any time at weekends
items.prompt: Off-peak members can use the centre

options.text: between 10 am and 4 pm on weekdays.

explanation.en: “only between 10 am and 4 pm on weekdays and at any time at weekends” → C. B is wrong: “only at weekends” leaves out weekdays.
explanation.kk: «only between 10 am and 4 pm on weekdays and at any time at weekends» → C. B қате: «only at weekends» жұмыс күндерін алып тастайды.
explanation.ru: «only between 10 am and 4 pm on weekdays and at any time at weekends» → C. B неверен: «only at weekends» отбрасывает будние дни.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–2. Read Text A. Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

items.quote: All members can bring a guest for £5 per visit
items.prompt: Which TWO statements are true for all members?

options.text: They can bring a guest for £5.
They can change membership type every three months.
They can use the pool at any time.

explanation.en: “All members can bring a guest for £5” (A) and “Members can change their membership type once every three months” (C). Classes (B) are not in swim-only, the pool “at any time” (E) is not off-peak, and £32 (D) is standard only.
explanation.kk: «All members can bring a guest for £5» (A) және «Members can change their membership type once every three months» (C). Сабақтар (B) swim-only түріне кірмейді, бассейн «at any time» (E) off-peak үшін жабық, £32 (D) — тек standard.
explanation.ru: «All members can bring a guest for £5» (A) и «Members can change their membership type once every three months» (C). Классы (B) не входят в swim-only, бассейн «at any time» (E) недоступен off-peak, £32 (D) — только standard.

groups.instruction: Questions 3–4. Read Text A. Choose TWO letters, A–E.

items.quote: Existing members will move to standard membership automatically unless they choose a different option by 20 September
items.prompt: Existing members who do nothing before 20 September will

explanation.en: Members “will move to standard membership automatically unless they choose a different option by 20 September” → D. Anyone who does nothing moves to standard; losing membership or paying extra is not mentioned.
explanation.kk: Мүшелер «will move to standard membership automatically unless they choose a different option by 20 September» → D. Ештеңе таңдамағандар өздігінен standard түріне ауысады; мүшелікті жоғалту мен қосымша төлем мәтінде жоқ.
explanation.ru: Участники «will move to standard membership automatically unless they choose a different option by 20 September» → D. Кто ничего не выбрал, автоматически переходит на standard; потери членства и доплаты в тексте нет.

groups.instruction: Question 5. Read Text A. Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

items.quote: Guests who need to leave later can ask reception for a late check-out, which is free until 1 pm if rooms are available
items.prompt: A guest who wants to leave at 12.30 pm should

options.text: ask reception for a late check-out.

explanation.en: 12.30 is after 11 am but before 1 pm: “ask reception for a late check-out, which is free until 1 pm” → A. No fee is needed (B).
explanation.kk: 12.30 — 11 am-ден кеш, бірақ 1 pm-ден ерте: «ask reception for a late check-out, which is free until 1 pm» → A. Төлеудің (B) қажеті жоқ.
explanation.ru: 12.30 — позже 11 am, но раньше 1 pm: «ask reception for a late check-out, which is free until 1 pm» → A. Платить (B) не нужно.

items.quote: Guests who leave before 7 am can order a breakfast bag the evening before
items.prompt: Guests who leave before breakfast is served can

options.text: eat in the restaurant at 6 am.
order a breakfast bag the evening before.
have breakfast delivered to their room.

explanation.en: “Guests who leave before 7 am can order a breakfast bag the evening before” → C. Refunds (A) and room delivery (D) are not mentioned.
explanation.kk: «Guests who leave before 7 am can order a breakfast bag the evening before» → C. Ақшаны қайтару (A) мен бөлмеге жеткізу (D) мәтінде жоқ.
explanation.ru: «Guests who leave before 7 am can order a breakfast bag the evening before» → C. Возврата денег (A) и доставки в номер (D) в тексте нет.

groups.instruction: Questions 6–7. Read Text B. Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

items.quote: a spa that must be booked in advance
items.prompt: Which TWO things are true about the spa?

options.text: It must be booked in advance.
It is on the top floor.

explanation.en: “a spa that must be booked in advance” (A) and “Towels for the spa are provided” (B). It is the gym that is open 24 hours (D), and guests bring their own swimwear (C).
explanation.kk: «a spa that must be booked in advance» (A) және «Towels for the spa are provided» (B). Тәулік бойы спа емес, спортзал ашық (D); суға түсетін киімді өзіңіз әкелесіз (C).
explanation.ru: «a spa that must be booked in advance» (A) и «Towels for the spa are provided» (B). Круглосуточно работает спортзал, а не спа (D); купальник нужно брать свой (C).

groups.instruction: Questions 8–9. Read Text B. Choose TWO letters, A–E.

items.quote: has only 20 spaces, so it is not possible to reserve a space in advance

options.text: has a limited number of spaces.

explanation.en: “has only 20 spaces” → D. A contradicts the text: spaces cannot be reserved.
explanation.kk: «has only 20 spaces» → D. A мәтінге қайшы: орынды алдын ала брондау мүмкін емес.
explanation.ru: «has only 20 spaces» → D. A противоречит тексту: забронировать место нельзя.
